fields.title: Embed key-type metadata in serialized shard keys
fields.decision: Each ShardKey carries compact shard key type metadata, a code for the .NET type of each record-key column. The metadata is written at the front of every serialized form (binary, UTF-8 and external key) and checked when a key is deserialized as a specific generic type. Equality compares the shard id and key values only.
fields.context: Serialized keys now flow through channels where the reader may not know the generic types in advance, such as logging and Orleans grain ids.

alternatives.option: Keep the DataOrigin character, serialized as an 8-bit value.
alternatives.whyRejected: The DataOrigin was not helpful in any real-world development scenarios; it was a solution in search of a problem. It also add substantial development overhead that was not justified by the perceived benefit.
Deserialization would only work if the type was always known in advance. Orleans and certain logging scenarios do not always know this.

fields.consequences: Deserializing with the wrong generic types fails, and a ghost shard key can rebuild an unknown key. This is a requirement for logging and Orleans support.
